quotes.speaker: Tracy Morgan
quotes.summary_phrase: Tracy Morgan on his intense pre-game preparation routine
quotes.excerpt: I get taped up literally. I have my son go around twice, go around twice and then I'm going to the game.
quotes.quote: You know me, I get taped up before the game. I get taped up literally. I have my son go around twice, go around twice and then I'm going to the game. I'm taped up, because you never know, LeBron might sub me in. And I'm a catch in the flagrant too.

quotes.speaker: Spike Lee
quotes.summary_phrase: Spike Lee on the unique basketball culture of New York City
quotes.excerpt: New York City is a basketball town, basketball city.
quotes.quote: New York City is a basketball town, basketball city.

quotes.speaker: Jalen Brunson
quotes.summary_phrase: Jalen Brunson on his favorite celebrity interactions at games
quotes.excerpt: My favorite international is with Mariska, one of the favorite shows, SVU.
quotes.quote: My favorite international is with Mariska, one of the favorite shows, SVU.

quotes.speaker: Sussie Essman
quotes.summary_phrase: Sussie Essman on the unique atmosphere of Madison Square Garden
quotes.excerpt: Celebrity Row is uniquely New York because it's the Garden, which is as New York as you're going to get.
quotes.quote: Celebrity Row is uniquely New York because it's the Garden, which is as New York as you're going to get. And most of the people that are there are New Yorkers.

quotes.speaker: Tracy Morgan
quotes.summary_phrase: Tracy Morgan on why LeBron James cannot play in New York
quotes.excerpt: It's New York, that's why LeBron can't play here, because the lights are too bright and we too rowdy.
quotes.quote: It's New York, that's why LeBron can't play here, because the lights are too bright and we too rowdy.

quotes.speaker: Fat Joe
quotes.summary_phrase: Fat Joe on the star-studded nature of Knicks games
quotes.excerpt: I mean, it's like the Oscars at a basketball game.
quotes.quote: When I see Celebrity Row, I'm bugging out. I'm seeing Michael J. Fox, Ben Stiller, Timothée Chalamet, Spike is here all the time. I mean, it's like the Oscars at a basketball game.

quotes.speaker: Spike Lee
quotes.summary_phrase: Spike Lee on the joy of attending Knicks games
quotes.excerpt: That's my vice, going to the Garden and having fun and yelling and screaming.
quotes.quote: That's my vice, going to the Garden and having fun and yelling and screaming. Oh, here's the thing I love, talking to I know all the refs.

quotes.speaker: Tracy Morgan
quotes.summary_phrase: Tracy Morgan on his courtside experience and triple-double claim
quotes.excerpt: You look to your right and Clyde and Breen is right there.
quotes.quote: You look to your right and Clyde and Breen is right there. When I threw up, I threw up, they call me. You okay? Guess what, I have a triple-double too, because I and threw up. I had a triple-double too.

quotes.speaker: Fat Joe
quotes.summary_phrase: Fat Joe on his history with the Knicks and courtside prayers
quotes.excerpt: It's an honor. I used to sit upper deck and so every time I sit courtside, I look up.
quotes.quote: It's an honor. I used to sit upper deck and so every time I sit courtside, I look up and I give a big giant prayer.

quotes.speaker: Sussie Essman
quotes.summary_phrase: Sussie Essman on the intimate fan experience at Knicks games
quotes.excerpt: You feel like you're on the court even though I'm not playing, thank God.
quotes.quote: You feel like you're on the court even though I'm not playing, thank God. But you feel like you're intimately involved in the game in a way that I don't think any other sport has really.

quotes.speaker: Spike Lee
quotes.summary_phrase: Spike Lee on his identity as an artist rather than a celebrity
quotes.excerpt: I pay for my seats. I don't think myself a celebrity, I'm a filmmaker. I'm an artist.
quotes.quote: I pay for my seats. I don't think myself a celebrity, I'm a filmmaker. I'm an artist.

quotes.speaker: Sussie Essman
quotes.summary_phrase: Sussie Essman on the shared passion of Knicks fans
quotes.excerpt: For all die-hard Knicks fans forever, we're no different than everybody else in that room, we're all fans.
quotes.quote: For all die-hard Knicks fans forever, we're no different than everybody else in that room, we're all fans.

quotes.speaker: Tracy Morgan
quotes.summary_phrase: Tracy Morgan on the connection between fans and players
quotes.excerpt: We are invested in our team, and those players on the court feel our energy.
quotes.quote: You see all those people in the Garden? I'm one of them. I'm one of them. Just fans. We are invested in our team, and those players on the court feel our energy. They feel us.

quotes.speaker: Karl-Anthony Towns
quotes.summary_phrase: Karl-Anthony Towns on the energy fans bring to the game
quotes.excerpt: It's great to have Celebrity Row, but when you see those fans, the energy they bring to the game.
quotes.quote: It's great to have Celebrity Row, but when you see those fans, the energy they bring to the game and they give to us, I mean, for real, everyone's a celebrity in there. Doesn't need to be in Celebrity Row to be a celebrity. It really all celebrities to us.
